---
title: "Troubleshoot a modeling workflow"
description: "Source-backed diagnoses and repairs for common fmrimod failures and misleading green checks."
---

Use this page after you can reproduce the problem in the supported project
environment. Keep the complete exception or warning, the fit's
`condition_report()` when available, and the command that produced it. The
[mental model](../concepts/mental-model.qmd) explains which object owns each
piece of context.

## Find the relevant failure first

| Symptom | First place to look |
|---|---|
| Rank-deficiency warning or unstable coefficients | Design columns and `fit.condition_report()` |
| Semantic contrast cannot resolve | Contrast term, level, basis, and design provenance |
| Mixed-TR construction or concatenation fails | TR count, run lengths, and sampling precision |
| `to_nifti()` or `to_neurovol()` fails | The result's spatial context |
| Group fit rejects a formula or method | Supported formula, estimator, and backend combination |
| Import or adapter construction fails | The optional dependency for that boundary |
| R parity suite is green but skipped | The terminal `R PARITY:` summary |
| Documentation renders old output | Quarto freeze and cache state |

## The design is rank deficient

**Symptom.** `fmri_lm()` warns that the design matrix is rank deficient. The
fit may still complete, but one or more individual coefficients are not
uniquely identified.

**Cause.** Exact or near-exact linear dependence exists among design columns.
The solver uses an SVD pseudoinverse. Contrasts in the estimable row space can
remain valid even when aliased coefficient directions do not.

**Repair.** Inspect `fit.condition_report()` and the named aliased columns.
Remove or combine redundant scientific regressors. If the dependence is in a
nuisance model, use its documented `nuisance_check="drop"` route deliberately
rather than silencing the warning. Refit and confirm that the intended
contrast is estimable.

The executable contract is in
[`test_rank_diagnostics.py`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_glm/test_rank_diagnostics.py).
For parity interpretation, read the active residual-degrees-of-freedom row in
[`CAVEATS.md`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/docs/contracts/CAVEATS.md).

## A semantic contrast cannot resolve

**Symptom.** Resolution reports a missing condition, an ambiguous term, an
ambiguous multi-basis effect, or weak design provenance. The error includes a
repair path.

**Cause.** The requested meaning does not identify one valid set of realized
columns. Common cases are repeated condition labels across terms, an SPMG2 or
SPMG3 condition without a basis selection, and an external matrix whose
inferred columns do not establish term or level identity.

**Repair.** Follow the error's repair text. Select the intended term when a
condition occurs in more than one term. For a single component, specify
`basis="canonical"`, `"derivative"`, or `"dispersion"` (or an explicit
`basis_ix`). For a joint multi-basis effect, use an omnibus contrast. Supply
explicit `DesignColumns` when importing a matrix; do not repair ambiguity with
regular-expression column matching.

See [Contrasts](../tutorials/contrasts.qmd) and the focused
[`condition_basis` tests](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_contrast/test_condition_basis_kwarg.py)
and
[`semantic repair-hint tests`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_contrast/test_semantic_repair_hint.py).

## Mixed-TR data fail before or during concatenation

**Symptom.** Construction reports that the TR list does not match the number
of runs, or concatenating two `SamplingFrame` objects reports different
precision.

**Cause.** Mixed TRs are supported. The actual inconsistency is usually one TR
per run not matching `run_length`, convolution precision that is not smaller
than the minimum TR, or two sampling frames with different precision.
Concatenation does not resample one frame to match another.

**Repair.** Provide one run length and one TR for each run. Choose a common,
valid convolution precision when frames will be concatenated. Construct the
multi-run dataset from that consistent sampling description. Use the concat
engine when the scientific question requires a single stacked fit or a
cross-run contrast; use the runwise engine for separate fits and combination.

The supported behavior is exercised in
[`test_mixed_tr.py`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_dataset/test_mixed_tr.py)
and the
[`mixed-TR parity workflow`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/benchmarks/parity/tier_a_mixed_tr_multirun/workflow.py).

## The contrast is valid but spatial export fails

**Symptom.** `ContrastResult.to_nifti()` or `.to_neurovol()` says the result
has no spatial context.

**Cause.** The fit came from a plain feature matrix, or its adapter did not
carry the mask and affine needed to map features back to a volume. A vector
length alone cannot establish image geometry.

**Repair.** When the data are spatial, build and fit an image-, nibabel-, or
neuroim-backed dataset with the correct mask and affine so that context
propagates into the contrast. Attach a `SpatialContext` manually only when you
actually know the feature-to-volume mapping. For intentionally nonspatial
features, keep the array result instead of fabricating a NIfTI geometry.

See
[`test_contrast_to_neurovol.py`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_glm/test_contrast_to_neurovol.py)
for both the refusal and the propagation contract.

## A group formula or method is rejected

**Symptom.** A group call raises `NotImplementedError` or rejects a formula,
estimator, robustness option, or backend.

**Cause.** The supported combinations are narrower than the individual option
names suggest:

- `fmri_ttest()` implements the one-sample `~ 1` case; Welch is not
  implemented there.
- Native meta-analysis supports FE and DL with covariates. PM and REML are
  intercept-only.
- The `fmrigds-r` oracle/fallback backend accepts FE and DL, not PM or REML,
  and does not accept custom weights, robust mode, or combine mode.

**Repair.** Choose a supported combination rather than changing the string
until it parses: use intercept-only PM/REML, use FE or DL for a covariate
meta-regression, use the one-sample t-test path for `fmri_ttest()`, or use the
native Python backend when the R bridge does not implement the requested
feature. Validate that the revised model still answers the scientific
question.

Read [Group analysis](../tutorials/group-analysis.qmd), the
[`second-level parity contract`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/docs/contracts/second_level_parity_v1.md),
and the executable
[`meta-regression`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_stats/test_meta_re_reg_parity.py)
and
[`fmrigds backend`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_stats/test_group_fit_fmrigds_parity.py)
tests.

## An optional boundary is unavailable

**Symptom.** An adapter, exporter, BIDS reader, HDF5 path, or R comparison
fails with a missing dependency.

**Cause.** The core install does not import every integration dependency.
Nibabel, PyBIDS, h5py, neuroim, rpy2, Nilearn, R, and the R reference packages
are installed only for the boundaries that need them.

**Repair.** From an installed-user environment, add the smallest missing
integration directly:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pip install nibabel   # image and NIfTI boundaries
.venv/bin/python -m pip install pybids    # BIDS discovery
.venv/bin/python -m pip install h5py      # HDF5 storage
```

From a source clone, install the matching project extra instead:

```bash
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[nibabel]"
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[bids]"
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[hdf5]"
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[cross-test]"
```

The neuroim adapter additionally needs the sibling
[`neuroim-python`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/neuroim-python) package. The R
bridge needs an available `Rscript` and the R package it invokes. Missing-
dependency messages are tested in
[`test_optional_dependency_errors.py`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/tests/test_dataset/test_optional_dependency_errors.py).

## R parity was skipped

**Symptom.** Pytest is green, but the terminal ends with `R PARITY: NOT
CHECKED`, or all R-backed cases are skipped.

**Cause.** `rpy2`, R, or the required R reference package is unavailable. A
skip is an environment result, not evidence of agreement.

**Repair.** Install the cross-test extra and the required R package, then turn
the skip into a hard failure:

```bash
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[cross-test]"
R -e 'remotes::install_github("bbuchsbaum/fmrihrf")'
FMRIMOD_REQUIRE_R=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest cross_testing/
```

The guard and terminal summary are implemented in
[`cross_testing/conftest.py`](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/cross_testing/conftest.py).
Review the reported number of R-backed tests before making a parity claim.

## Documentation shows frozen output

**Symptom.** A Quarto page renders successfully but shows output from an older
execution, or a code change does not alter the rendered result.

**Cause.** The documentation project uses `freeze: auto` and caching. A normal
render may reuse checked-in `_freeze` output. That behavior supports stable
site builds, but it is not proof that every notebook executed from a clean
state.

**Repair.** Use a disposable checkout for a freshness check. Remove its
`docs/_freeze`, then render the docs with `quarto render --no-cache`. Keep this
separate from an ordinary publishing build so the tracked freeze artifacts in
your working checkout are not deleted accidentally. The hosted
[`docs-freshness` workflow](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrimod/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs-freshness.yml)
uses that exact clean-execution policy and does not publish the site.

## Continue from here

- Return to [Golden path](../tutorials/golden-path.qmd) after the local failure
  is resolved.
- Use [How to read the evidence](../evidence/index.qmd) before turning a green
  run into a broader correctness or release claim.
- If the observed behavior contradicts the linked test, retain the smallest
  reproducer, complete environment details, and the exact fmrimod revision.
